time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
pixel_coords: x right, y down, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake). Spotlight disc on the wall stays fixed: centroid drifts < 10 px over the clip, bounding box x 96-108 / 2035-2043, y 1084-1096 / 3003-3015 (drift is from the moving hand/card occluding part of the disc, not camera motion). Track: tracks/spotlight.csv

objects.name: red_card
objects.description: Red/pink credit card ('CREDIT CARD' text, gold chip at left, '0000 0000 0000 0000'), held horizontally by a right hand at its right end; the only moving prop. Long axis horizontal in the image.
objects.occlusion: right end partly covered by the thumb/fingers every frame; the bottom-right corner below the fingers is visible so bbox_x1 still reaches the card's right edge (checked on overlays, +-5 px). Frames 0-8 motion-blurred.

pixel_size.length_along_long_axis_px: ~473 (mean bbox_w frames 18-27, sharp, card facing camera; per-frame 450-489). Earlier frames shorter (388 at frame 0, ~455 frames 7-16) because the card is tilted out of plane / blurred at the start.
pixel_size.short_side_height_px: ~298 (frames 9-27 bbox_h 295-302); 324 in frames 0-2 (card closer to camera at the start)

motion_summary_px.reference_point: bbox centre (cx_bbox, cy_bbox); also mask centroid and top-left corner (bbox_x0, bbox_y0) in the csv
motion_summary_px.direction: up and to the left, ~120 deg from +x in image coords (dx -325, dy -552)

objects.name: hand_arm
objects.description: Person's right hand and forearm entering from the lower right, gripping the card's right end; moves rigidly with the card.

objects.name: card_shadow
objects.description: Dark rectangular shadow of the card on the wall, to the lower-left of the card; only its left part is visible (the rest is behind the card).
objects.track: tracks/card_shadow.csv (visible part; bbox_x0 = shadow left edge, bbox_y0/y1 = shadow top/bottom)
objects.note: Horizontal gap card-left-edge minus shadow-left-edge shrinks from 200 px (frame 0) to ~100 px (frame 27): the card moves toward the wall as it moves up-left.

objects.name: spotlight_disc
objects.description: Bright circular pool of light on the pink wall, dark vignette around it. Static.

pixel_extent_frame27.diameter_px: ~1935 wide x ~1911 tall (threshold 60% of peak brightness on a blurred image; soft edge, +-50 px)

objects.name: wall
objects.description: Flat pink wall/backdrop filling the frame; the plane the card moves parallel to.

events.event: card already moving at first frame (motion blur); motion is up-left
card essentially at rest (steps 2-5 px/frame, jitter level)
card rotates in-plane slightly: long-axis angle ~-2 deg (frames 0-3) -> 0 (6-16) -> ~+2 deg (21-27)
